data.narrative:
BlackSea Technologies, a Defense & Security platform company incubated by Razor's Edge Ventures, operates within a sector comprised of 23 peer companies across public and private markets. The comp universe includes 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with top-tier private comparables including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Traditional peer-median valuation is not applicable in this instance. The Defense & Security sector lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a robust peer multiple approach. Narrowing the universe to directly comparable platform-stage companies yielded fewer than three datapoints, the minimum threshold required for meaningful triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial error given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security company profiles and stage distributions.

Without applicable quantitative triangulation methods, a defensible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. The identified peer set—particularly Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI—warrants qualitative benchmarking on capital efficiency, customer concentration, and technical differentiation, but quantitative conclusions require either (1) expanded comparable data, (2) bottom-up revenue/margin projections, or (3) internal rate-of-return expectations from platform sponsors. The current information supports positioning BlackSea within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort but does not support a specific valuation estimate.
